name: Loss Scheduling for Candidate Head
definition: A training strategy that gradually reduces the influence of an image-dependent 'candidate head' (Ĉi) during training, transitioning to a shared representation (Ĉ) to stabilize pose estimation for hard-pose images.
summary: Loss scheduling gradually shifts training from image-specific candidate heads to a shared representation via a cosine schedule, stabilizing pose estimation for hard-pose images.
